quotes.text: FIX reconstruct_from_patches_2d when patch size equals image size (#33643)
:func:`feature_extraction.image.reconstruct_from_patches_2d` now produces correct results when a patch dimension equals the corresponding image dimension.

summary: `reconstruct_from_patches_2d` rebuilds an image from overlapping patches, averaging each pixel over the patches that cover it. When a patch is as tall or as wide as the whole image (for example 128×128 patches of a 128×256 image), it divided by the wrong number of overlapping patches, so the rebuilt image was wrong. The test cuts a random image into patches and checks that putting them back gives the original image.
title: Rebuilding an image when a patch is as big as the image

whereToLook.hint: The loop at the end that divides each pixel by the amount of overlap.
